notes.title: NEW GAMEMODE UPDATE
notes.content:
This is the long-awaited update for Bengan Yes.

This update has been in the works for the last couple of months due to a lack of motivation, and it will likely be the last update for quite some time. However, this update is quite substantial and features a new game mode, translations, optimization fixes, and a proper main menu.

Changes : 
Player models heavily optimized, resulting in more fps.
Multiple UI-elements now scales your resolution better.
The text for player now have an outline, making them easier to look at and differentiate.
New gamemode where twitch-chat and the streamer teams up to solve puzzles.
Translations for swedish and english.
Other programming optimization fixes.
New achivement for completing the BENGAN bros campaign (the new gamemode).

There are alot of other changes we have not written down since we don't remember. This is quite a huge update and debugging months old code has been irritating, so don't be suprised if you find any bugs. If you do find any bugs, please write them in the discussions tab. If you are streaming and encountering a bug, make a clip of the bug named "BUG", and i will check those clips directly from twitch's website.
